title: Axia Public Relations Scholarship
provider: PRSA Foundation and Axia Public Relations
summary: Scholarship assisting an outstanding college student with financial need who is pursuing a public relations career.
eligibility: College students pursuing public relations who meet the current academic and financial-need requirements.

title: Betsy Plank/PRSSA Scholarships
award: $5,000 first place; $1,500 second place; $1,000 third place
summary: Three scholarships recognizing outstanding public relations students for achievement, leadership and professional commitment.
eligibility: College juniors and seniors with strong academics, leadership, practical experience and commitment to public relations.

title: Chester Burger Scholarship for Excellence in Public Relations
summary: Graduate scholarship encouraging students to pursue careers in corporate public relations.
eligibility: Graduate students studying public relations, journalism or a related field with at least a 3.0 undergraduate GPA.

title: Geoffrey M. Curtis Scholarship
summary: Scholarship supporting a BIPOC student pursuing a career in public relations, journalism or communications.
eligibility: BIPOC-identifying rising college juniors or seniors pursuing public relations, journalism or communications careers.

title: Lawrence G. Foster Award
summary: Educational award recognizing a student with outstanding potential as a future public relations professional.
eligibility: Current PRSSA members who meet the award's application requirements.

title: Ofield Dukes Multicultural Student Award
summary: Award recognizing a multicultural public relations junior for outstanding academic achievement.
eligibility: Eligible college juniors from racial or ethnic groups identified in the current program rules who are pursuing public relations.

title: PRSA Diversity Multicultural Scholarship
summary: Two scholarships for talented multicultural undergraduate communications students.
eligibility: Eligible undergraduate communications students from racial or ethnic groups identified in the program rules with at least a 3.0 GPA.

title: PRSA Puget Sound Scholarships
summary: Scholarships recognizing Washington students who demonstrate academic achievement, financial need and interest in public relations.
eligibility: Students attending school in Washington State who intend to practice public relations and meet current academic and financial-need requirements.

title: Greenough Fellowship
summary: Scholarship and Boston internship for a BIPOC student studying public relations, journalism, marketing or communications.
eligibility: BIPOC-identifying students pursuing an eligible major or minor who meet the fellowship's current internship requirements.

title: Hannah Cranston Media Fellowship
provider: PRSA Foundation and Hannah Cranston Media
award: $3,000 scholarship and paid twelve-week part-time internship
summary: Scholarship and New York internship for a student pursuing a public relations or communications career.
eligibility: Students pursuing public relations or communications who can meet the current New York internship requirements.

title: Hirsch Leatherwood Fellowship
award: $2,500 scholarship and paid eight-week part-time internship
summary: Scholarship and New York internship for a student pursuing public relations or communications.
eligibility: Students pursuing a public relations or communications career who meet the fellowship's current internship requirements.

title: Kite Hill Fellowship
award: $1,500 scholarship and paid three-month part-time internship
summary: Scholarship and internship in Miami or New York for a student studying PR, journalism, marketing or communications.
eligibility: Students pursuing an eligible major or minor who can meet the current Miami or New York internship requirements.

title: Scout Lab Fellowship
award: $2,500 scholarship and paid three-week remote internship
summary: Scholarship and short remote internship for a student pursuing public relations or communications.
eligibility: Students pursuing public relations or communications who meet the fellowship's current application and remote-internship requirements.

title: V2 Communications Fellowship
award: $2,500 scholarship and paid eight-week full-time internship
summary: Scholarship and Boston internship for a BIPOC student studying communications, journalism, PR or related marketing fields.
eligibility: BIPOC-identifying students pursuing an eligible major who meet the fellowship's current Boston internship requirements.

title: Musicians Institute Industry Scholarships
summary: Multiple scholarships for students in audio engineering, music business, production, studio recording and live-event programs.
eligibility: New or continuing Musicians Institute students who meet the requirements for a listed program-specific scholarship.

title: College of Journalism and Communications Scholarships
provider: University of Florida College of Journalism and Communications
award: More than $500,000 awarded per school year across scholarships
institution: University of Florida College of Journalism and Communications
summary: Privately funded undergraduate scholarships for degree-seeking students in the College of Journalism and Communications.
eligibility: Degree-seeking University of Florida undergraduates whose primary major is within the College of Journalism and Communications.

title: Bil VornDick Scholarship
award: Scholarship support; consult the current application
summary: Scholarship supporting an undergraduate studying audio engineering or music production in Tennessee.
eligibility: Undergraduate students pursuing audio engineering or music production at an accredited Tennessee program who meet current AES requirements.

title: IEEE BTS/AFCCE Jules Cohen Memorial Scholarship
provider: IEEE Broadcast Technology Society and AFCCE
summary: Scholarship for promising engineering students interested in broadcast engineering or broadcast technology careers.
eligibility: College juniors, seniors or graduate students attending accredited U.S. universities with an interest in broadcast engineering or technology.

title: Ennes Educational Foundation Youth Scholarship
award: Award amount announced with the current cycle
summary: Scholarship for a graduating high school senior preparing for education leading to a broadcast-engineering career.
eligibility: Graduating high school seniors planning to enroll in a technical school, college or university and pursue broadcast engineering studies.

title: Audio Girl Summer Training Program Scholarship
summary: Training scholarship covering music business, marketing, release strategy, project management and distribution.
eligibility: Applicants who meet the Audio Girl Foundation's current age, program and participation requirements.
